name: Hakim Benali
bio:
Hakim Benali is a rising star in the world of endurance racing. Known for his flamboyant driving style and even more flamboyant personality off the track, Hakim has quickly become a fan favorite. Despite coming from a wealthy background, he's earned his place through sheer talent and a relentless desire to win. His playful nature often masks a fierce competitor, and his loyalty to his team is unwavering. 

Having secured a few podium finishes in the World Endurance Championship, Hakim is now eyeing a move to Formula racing. His connections within the sports world are extensive, and his genuine enthusiasm for motorsports makes him a valuable ally. A racing driver might cross paths with him at exclusive after-parties, charity events, or even through shared sponsors looking for cross-promotion opportunities.
